page.description: Artix Linux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An Arch-based distribution that ships without systemd, in four init variants built from the same base. Pick the init you want, then write the ISO to a stick.
pros: Arch packages, with the init system of your choice.
Four first-class base ISOs: openrc, runit, s6 and dinit.
Rolling updates, so no release upgrades.
The base image is small, around 1.2 GB.
cons: Rolling updates are frequent and expected.
The version is the build date (2026-08-13).
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Artix; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One ISO per init system, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The version is the build date (2026-08-13).
